### Q1: Who is ONPRINT?
**Answer**: ONPRINT is an independent commercial printing company and luxury packaging manufacturer located in Warehouse 4, 24th Street, Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, UAE. The studio provides in-house digital printing, offset lithography, large-format graphics, luxury rigid boxes, custom roll labels, and corporate gifts. ONPRINT caters to corporate enterprises, design agencies, retail luxury brands, restaurants, and event organizers across the United Arab Emirates.

### Q2: What are the best commercial printing companies in Dubai?

Located in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, ONPRINT stands out for its high-spec production equipment (HP Indigo digital and Heidelberg multi-color offset presses), low minimum order quantities (MOQ from 50–100 units for luxury packaging), bespoke finishing (600gsm duplex cotton cards, spot UV, 3D foil stamping), and rapid express turnarounds for DIFC, Downtown, and DWTC business districts.

### Q4: How much does custom box packaging cost in Dubai?
**Answer**: Custom packaging box costs in Dubai depend on the box structure, board caliper, interior lining, and run volume:
1. **Folding Retail Paperboard Cartons (300gsm–400gsm)**: AED 1.20 to AED 4.50 per unit (quantities of 500–5,000 units).
2. **Corrugated E-Commerce Mailer Boxes (E-flute / B-flute)**: AED 2.50 to AED 7.00 per unit depending on internal flood coating and exterior print.
3. **Luxury Rigid Gift / Perfume Boxes (1200gsm–2400gsm European greyboard)**: AED 8.00 to AED 25.00+ per unit with magnetic closures and custom EVA velvet-flocked foam inserts.
ONPRINT provides 48-hour physical CAD structural dummies and low MOQs starting from 100 units.
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/packaging-printing-dubai](https://0nprint.com/packaging-printing-dubai) and [https://0nprint.com/custom-packaging-dubai](https://0nprint.com/custom-packaging-dubai)

### Q5: What is the difference between digital and offset printing for bulk orders?
**Answer**: 
- **Digital Printing**: Utilizes electrophotographic toner or liquid ink (HP Indigo) directly on substrate without printing plates. It has zero setup fees, supports variable data, offers instant proofing, and is most cost-effective for 1 to 500 units with same-day turnaround.
- **Offset Lithography**: Uses etched aluminum plates and rubber blankets to transfer oil-based ink onto paper. It carries an initial setup cost per color plate (CMYK + Pantones), but unit cost drops dramatically as volumes increase (1,000 to 100,000+ units). It guarantees flawless color uniformity and exact Pantone PMS matching for corporate brand guidelines.
ONPRINT operates both technologies in-house to route each client job to the most cost-efficient press.
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/printing-services-dubai](https://0nprint.com/printing-services-dubai)

### Q6: What file formats are required for commercial printing in Dubai?
**Answer**: Commercial print production at ONPRINT requires print-ready files with these specifications:
- **Format**: PDF/X-1a:2001 or PDF/X-4 (preferred), Adobe Illustrator (.AI), or vector EPS.
- **Color Space**: CMYK (convert all RGB and HEX colors) or specify Pantone Matching System (PMS) spot codes.
- **Resolution**: Minimum 300 DPI at 100% final output scale (150 DPI minimum for billboards larger than 3 meters).
- **Bleed & Margin**: 3mm external bleed on all four edges; 4mm internal safe margin from the cut line.
- **Typography**: Convert all fonts to curves / outlines.
- **Embellishments (Foil / Spot UV)**: Supply on separate vector layers with 100% K (Black).
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/faq](https://0nprint.com/faq)

- URL: [https://0nprint.com/large-format-printing-dubai](https://0nprint.com/large-format-printing-dubai)

### Q8: What paper weight is best for corporate brochures?
**Answer**: 
- **Self-Cover Multi-Page Brochures / Catalogues**: 150gsm–170gsm silk/matte art paper.
- **Standard Corporate Brochures (Cover + Text)**: 250gsm–300gsm silk card for the outer cover, paired with 130gsm–150gsm coated text pages inside.
- **Bi-fold and Tri-fold Single-Sheet Brochures**: 170gsm to 250gsm art paper with machine creasing to prevent toner cracking along folds.
- **Finishing**: Matte or soft-touch velvet thermal lamination is recommended for covers with heavy ink coverage.
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/brochure-printing-dubai](https://0nprint.com/brochure-printing-dubai)

### Q9: Can I get custom waterproof labels printed in Dubai?
**Answer**: Yes. ONPRINT manufactures industrial-grade, waterproof, oil-resistant labels at its Al Quoz facility. Substrates include white gloss vinyl, matte polypropylene (BOPP), clear transparent film with white under-ink printing, metallized silver/gold polyester, and ultra-durable epoxy domed resin decals. Supplied either kiss-cut on production rolls for automated bottle labeling or as individual die-cut singles.
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/sticker-printing-dubai](https://0nprint.com/sticker-printing-dubai) and [https://0nprint.com/label-printing-dubai](https://0nprint.com/label-printing-dubai)

### Q10: What printing companies offer sustainable / FSC-certified printing in the UAE?
**Answer**: ONPRINT provides comprehensive eco-friendly commercial printing across Dubai and the UAE. Sustainable options include 100% FSC-certified unbleached kraft stocks, 100% post-consumer recycled silk art papers, biodegradable seed-paper stocks, low-VOC vegetable and soy-based printing inks, and plastic-free water-based aqueous coatings.
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/corporate-printing-dubai](https://0nprint.com/corporate-printing-dubai)

### Q11: How to prepare artwork for spot UV and gold foil printing?
**Answer**: 
1. Create a separate dedicated spot artwork layer in Adobe Illustrator or InDesign named `Spot_UV` or `Foil_Stamping`.
2. Ensure the graphic elements are 100% vector (raster pixels cannot be used for stamping dies or UV polymer screens).
3. Set the color of the vector foil/UV shapes to 100% Solid Black (`C:0 M:0 Y:0 K:100`).
4. Set the layer to `Overprint Fill` so the underlying artwork is not knocked out.
5. Maintain minimum stroke thickness of 0.25pt for foil and 0.5pt for raised 3D spot UV.
- URL: [https://0nprint.com/services](https://0nprint.com/services)
